text: SpaceX Starship Flight 14 launch before October 1, 2026 (launch-site local date)?
yes: If SpaceX launches Starship flight test number 14 After issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. Launch means liftoff with sustained ascent; scrubs and static fires do not count, while a failure after liftoff still counts. Only flight test 14 after market issuance counts. The calendar boundary is launch-site local time; the numeric deadline uses America/Chicago for Starbase and must be flagged if the launch site differs.
no: No event satisfying the YES contract within its specified window.
void: Record void/disputed if Kalshi cancels, returns a nonbinary settlement, or rule interpretation prevents matching the frozen contract. Preserve history.
